newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Chinese targeted again in latest Budapest killing.
newsitem.headline: Chinese targeted again in latest Budapest killing.

text.p: A 51-year-old Chinese market seller was found dead in his home in the third killing in two weeks involving Hungary's Chinese community, police said on Thursday.
"He was shot several times in the head by someone who clearly knew him," police told Reuters. "The flat was locked after the murder and it seems valuable electronic goods were not touched."
The man, who police said had been living in Hungary for years, was discovered on Wednesday by friends who broke into the flat after he failed to answer telephone calls.
Four Chinese have been killed in Budapest in the last two weeks.
The body of a Chinese man, beaten to death, was found in a Budapest flat on Saturday, one week after a hand grenade attack killed the wife and daughter of a Chinese restaurant owner.
Since last September, Budapest has been shaken by a score of bombings and at least a half dozen shootings in an apparent gangland war, which previously had affected only Hungarians.
